summary: Implemented the Tabs widget in the repository without running or committing anything. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/_tabs.py with Tabs (click on label or bar activates nearest tab, left/right arrows cycle with wrap, digits 1-9 pick by number, letters cycle through labels starting with that letter) and a TabActivated message; exports added to src/textual/widgets/__init__.py; new sandbox/tabs.py demo (python -m tabs); CHANGELOG Unreleased entry. Verification was by reading only; no tests were added or run, and nothing was committed. Known limits: number keys cover only 1-9, and layout height is fixed at 2 rows.
